module: Part of the third-party LuaIRC library (IRC client). Module "irc": parsing of IRC protocol lines (parse), nicknames and prefixes (parseNick, parsePrefix, parseAccess), nickname validation, fallback nickname generator, and mIRC formatting (colors, bold, underline).
usage:
local prefix, cmd, params = irc.parse(":nick!user@host PRIVMSG #chan :hello")
-- prefix = "nick!user@host", cmd = "PRIVMSG", params = {"#chan", "hello"}

color.desc: mIRC color codes (black=1 ... white=16). The table is also callable: color(text, nameOrNumber) returns the text surrounded by the 0x03 byte and the number.

parse.desc: Splits a raw IRC line into prefix (without the leading ':'), command and parameter list. The final parameter introduced by ' :' is added last.

parseNick.desc: Separates the access symbols (@, +) from the nickname, as in a NAMES list.

parsePrefix.desc: Parses a nick!user@host prefix into a table {access, nick, username, host}. Without a valid prefix, only the default access rights are filled in.

parseAccess.desc: Converts a string of symbols into a table {op, halfop, voice} (@ = op, % = halfop, + = voice).

bold.desc: Surrounds the text with the mIRC bold control byte (0x02).

underline.desc: Surrounds the text with the mIRC underline control byte (0x1F).

checkNick.desc: Checks that a nickname only contains valid IRC characters and does not start with a digit or a hyphen.

defaultNickGenerator.desc: Generates a replacement nickname by incrementing the code of a randomly chosen character (goes back to 65 if outside 65..125). Used when the nickname is refused (codes 432/433).
